source.provider: x402scan public pages — manual research seed

methodology.name: human-researched public x402scan observations
notes: Values were transcribed as approximate public dashboard observations during Product Discovery Round 4.
Seller/server, receiving-wallet, buyer, and transaction meanings remain those of the source pages.
This file is a dated manual seed and is not a live collection.

limitations: Approximate values may have changed since observation.
Aggregate pages do not expose enough evidence to calculate buyer concentration or prove buyer independence.
Missing volume, resource, price, network, and facilitator values remain unknown rather than zero.
Use current source pages or authorized transaction-level evidence before making a product decision.
